claims.scope: Formal update/projection properties under the assumptions stated in Chapter 3; this does not establish detector accuracy or closed-loop benefit.
claims.permitted_wording: The method specifies evidence-linked state updates and a causal projection contract under explicit assumptions.

claims.scope: Locked V2 T1/T3/base dataset inventory and observation/action/image alignment only.
claims.permitted_wording: The V2 corpus contains 698 episodes and passed the recorded alignment audit over 180,447 state/action rows and 1,396 adapter-parity samples.

claims.scope: Open-loop replay on fixed author demonstrations; no policy action or success effect is measured.
claims.permitted_wording: D0-D2 replay describes query and trigger schedules on recorded trajectories and is not a policy score.

claims.scope: Pinned local T7 source and raw evaluator replay with author actions.
claims.permitted_wording: The refined T7 source hash matches the pinned LFS OID, and RGB author-action replay exercised each Or branch.

claims.scope: One author-refined T7 demonstration; writer output plus per-frame detector comparison to released author exo-boxes; no identity/relation accuracy or policy score.
claims.permitted_wording: On one T7 training demonstration, the relation writer produced no memory fact in 425 samples and reported unknown relations throughout; against released exo-box annotations at IoU 0.5, bowl detector precision/recall was 0.893/0.747 and plate precision/recall was 0.971/0.646. These frame-level detection results do not establish identity tracking or relation accuracy.

claims.scope: One author-refined T8 training demonstration; RGB relation writer output only, without independent identity/relation labels or policy rollout.
claims.permitted_wording: On one T8 training demonstration, the RGB relation writer produced no memory fact in 613 samples and relation state remained unknown throughout. This is a single-demo writer diagnostic, not independent identity/relation accuracy or a policy score.

claims.scope: One author-refined T9 training demonstration; RGB relation writer output only, without independent identity/containment labels or policy rollout.
claims.permitted_wording: On one T9 training demonstration, the RGB relation writer produced no memory fact in 356 samples and relation state remained unknown throughout. This is a single-demo writer diagnostic, not independent identity/containment accuracy or a policy score.

claims.scope: Six previously observed T1/T3 demonstrations from the historical RGB cycle-writer audit.
claims.permitted_wording: The earlier cycle-writer audit matched its annotated milestones on the selected demonstrations within the reported tolerance.

claims.scope: Two separate custom evidence streams: historical B0/F1 T1/T3 pilot with 20 task episodes per condition, and the V2 E0 B0/F0 development pilot with one seen state per task and treatment.
claims.permitted_wording: The historical B0 and F1 pilot recorded 0/20 and 1/20 successes under the local protocol; a separate V2 seen-state pilot completed four B0/F0 episodes with 0/4 successes. Neither result estimates a causal memory effect.

claims.scope: Matched V2 policy pair verification and E2 closed-loop evaluation on 20 unseen state clusters completed. F0 achieved 10% macro success (15% T1, 5% T3) while F1 achieved 0% on both tasks (macro delta -10%) with a 5x wall-clock latency penalty due to 2D detector latency.
claims.permitted_wording: Matched F0 (no-memory) and F1 (relation-memory) V2 adapters completed E2 paired closed-loop evaluation on 20 unseen state clusters; F0 achieved 10% macro success while F1 achieved 0% with 5x longer wall time. Neither adapter establishes official benchmark competence.
claims.prohibited_wording: Claiming that memory improves task success, or claiming that F1 V2 is unavailable or un-evaluated.

claims.scope: Pinned-source environment integrity and simulator smoke only in exact Python 3.8.13 reference environment; no policy score is measured.
claims.permitted_wording: The pinned-source WSL environment passed strict validation with Python 3.8.13 and the LIBERO simulator smoke suite passed 14/14 under the exact provenance assertions; EGL fell back to kms_swrast and no policy score was generated.

claims.scope: Declared training/evaluation image transforms and code paths; the training-side LeRobot processor file hash is unavailable, and this does not explain E0 task failures.
claims.permitted_wording: The audit found no image-orientation mismatch in the declared training and evaluation transforms; byte-level identity of the training processor installation was not recorded.

claims.scope: One author-refined T10 training demonstration; RGB relation writer output only, without independent identity/containment labels or policy rollout.
claims.permitted_wording: On one T10 training demonstration, the RGB relation writer produced no memory fact in 309 samples; relation state remained unknown in all 309 samples and all 927 object identity observations were unknown. This is a single-demo writer diagnostic, not independent identity/containment accuracy or a policy score.

claims.scope: One upstream-style author-action replay each on T8, T9 and T10, plus T8 raw/refined source and per-step robot-state parity diagnostics; no policy, independent labels, or memory treatment.
claims.permitted_wording: One author-action replay reached terminal upstream success on T9 and T10. For T8 demo_1, the refined actions exactly match the pinned transform of raw actions and the initial states match, but replay robot state first exceeded the diagnostic 1e-5 tolerance at step 219; three milestones were reached without terminal success despite refined metainfo success=true. The cause remains unresolved. These one-demo diagnostics do not establish policy competence, writer accuracy, memory benefit, or an official score.
